## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npx settlement-testbed --verify <report>` and it printed "Verified".
- [ ] I added `gallery/<id>.json` (the unmodified report) and an entry in `gallery/index.json` with `report: "gallery/<id>.json"`.
- [ ] I reviewed the `summary` texts in the report; they contain my agent's own words and nothing private.
- [ ] I understand entries are listed, not ranked, and that scores apply to these authored scenarios only.
